reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text: I really enjoy this serum. The texture is light but nourishing, absorbs nicely without stickiness. My skin feels smoother, more hydrated and looks healthier. Works well for combination and mature skin. No irritation at all. A great serum for daily anti-aging care.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支精華。質地輕但有滋養感，吸收得好又唔會黐笠。皮膚摸起嚟滑咗、水潤咗，望落都健康咗。混合性同熟齡肌都好啱用。完全冇刺激。日常抗衰老護理嘅一支好精華。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text: It is my second time buying the product and I can say that it helps me a lot with acne and marks, it leaves my skin soft and hydrated, I use it at night because its consistency is a little sticky but it is an excellent product if you have acne and dry skin
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次回購呢件產品，我可以講佢對我處理暗瘡同痘印幫助好大，搽完之後皮膚又軟又保濕。我會喺夜晚用，因為質地有少少黐笠，但如果係暗瘡肌或者乾性肌，呢件產品真係一流。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text:
For individuals with acne-prone, oily skin, this serum offers a non-watery, slightly more viscous formulation. 

It is ideally suited for situations where a gentle approach and a lightweight serum are desired. The moisturizing properties of this product are significant, providing substantial hydration to the skin without a heavy sensation. 

It genuinely feels nice on your skin. Perfect for sencitive skin.
reviews.zh:
對暗瘡肌、油性肌嚟講，呢支精華提供唔似水狀、略為稠身嘅配方。

想搵溫和同輕盈精華嘅時候，佢就最啱。產品嘅保濕力強，可以為皮膚提供充足水分但又唔會有厚重感。

真係搽落舒服。敏感肌必備。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text: Tengo varias semanas utilizando este suero, es increíble el cambio en mi piel. Estoy cerca de los 40 y comencé a ver líneas de expresión, que desaparecieron con este suero lo adoro. Me encanta que no tiene perfume, huele a extracto medicinal, muy suave y nada fastidioso. Lo único que no me gusta de él es su tamaño, muy pequeño se acaba rápidamente.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢支精華幾個星期，皮膚嘅變化真係令人難以置信。我就嚟 40 歲，開始有表情紋，用咗呢支精華之後表情紋就消失晒，我好愛佢。超鍾意佢冇香料，聞落好似藥草萃取，好溫和一啲都唔會煩人。唯一唔鍾意嘅係容量，太細好快就用完。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text:
originally i had bought this for my mom, since her main focus on skin is reviving and anti-aging. but when i was visiting her, my own serum ran out! so i used some of her’s <3

my experience with it was pretty nice! my skin will get finnicky sometimes, and will break out if i use a particular product too much. thankfully, i haven’t had that issue with this serum! it does happen to have a strong ginseng smell, but i like that <3 my skin feels moisturized and isn’t irritated at all — which is a plus, given that my skin is sensitive. it does take a second to absorb, but this complaint can be negated if you just rub the serum around LOL
reviews.zh:
本來買呢支係畀阿媽用，因為佢護膚重點係活膚同抗衰老。但去探佢嗰陣，自己支精華用晒！於是用咗佢少少 <3

用落感覺幾好！我皮膚有時會變得敏感，用某啲產品太耐就會爆瘡。幸好用呢支精華冇出現呢個問題！佢真係有陣好強嘅人參味，但我鍾意 <3 皮膚感覺好保濕，完全冇刺激——以我敏感肌嚟講係加分。吸收係要少少時間，但只要搽開佢就冇問題 LOL

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text: I have combination skin, and haved used other beauty of joseon products without issue. But this really irritated my skin after only 2 uses. Inflammation, and itchy. I had to ice my face.
reviews.zh: 我係混合性肌，之前用 beauty of joseon 其他產品都冇問題。但呢支我淨係用咗兩次皮膚就即刻受刺激。發炎同痕癢。最後要冰敷塊面。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text:
help keep skin moisturised and protect damaged skin
Suitable for dry/oily/sensitive skin helps keep skin firm, reduce blemishes, & hyperpigmentation 
Supposedly it’s lightweight but it is a bit thick and gel like which makes absorption a bit tricky. Takes a while to dry down.
There’s a light earthy scent to this serum.
Because you only need 2-3 drops the bottle is quite small
reviews.zh:
幫助保持皮膚水潤，保護受損皮膚
適合乾性／油性／敏感肌，有助保持皮膚緊緻，減少瑕疵同色素沉澱
聲稱係輕盈，但實際有少少厚同 gel 狀，吸收比較慢。要等一陣先至乾透。
呢支精華有陣淡淡嘅泥土香。
因為每次只需要 2-3 滴，所以支嘢好細

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum: Ginseng + Snail Mucin 30mL
reviews.text: I found it to be a decent addition to my skincare routine. I’ve been using this for sometime now, although alternating in between the glow serum and other vitamin c and collagen serums. This serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs well and it does leave my skin feeling hydrated and soft. However, I haven’t seen significant changes in terms of fine lines or hyperpigmentation. Might have to use this religiously to see results. Overall, a good serum for basic hydration and skin maintenance.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢支係一個唔錯嘅護膚程序補充。我已經用咗一段時間，不過係同另一支 glow serum 同其他維他命 C、膠原蛋白精華交替用。呢支精華質地輕盈，吸收得好，真係令皮膚感覺水潤又柔軟。不過喺細紋同色素沉澱方面我未見到明顯改善。可能要持續用先見到效果。整體嚟講，作為基本保濕同皮膚保養係一支好精華。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
